title: Implement deterministic Scope / Lock Controller
description: Implement frozen multi-agent Item 3: deterministic write-scope validation, role-aware lock acquisition/release, overlap conflict detection, no-timeout active locks, read-only reviewer/QA enforcement, and terminal-state lock release.

why_medium: This controller becomes a repository-governance enforcement primitive for future task dispatch and write isolation.
A defect can incorrectly allow or block future task writes even though it does not mutate commerce, financial, auth, migration, or production business state.
The implementation is deterministic, additive, locally reversible, and isolated to the multi-agent governance surface.
why_not_high: No payment, pricing, inventory, authentication, authorization, finance, irreversible database migration, destructive production operation, or security-policy mutation is performed.
No protected-main rule, GitHub ruleset, or merge policy is changed by this task.
Rollback is a normal revert of three isolated files.

lock_contract.snapshot_semantics: Deep-cloned and recursively frozen read-only view; attempted caller mutation fails and cannot mutate controller state.

acceptance_criteria.description: Repository paths and supported scope patterns are normalized deterministically and fail closed on absolute paths, traversal, invalid glob syntax, or empty values.
Changed paths outside declared write scope or inside forbidden scope are deterministically rejected, with forbidden scope taking precedence.
Active lock records contain unique lock_id, task_id, owner, normalized paths, ACTIVE status and created_at; acquisition detects exact, prefix and nested-path conflicts and rejects duplicate lock IDs.
Only the owning task and agent may release a lock; release returns RELEASED status plus released_at and is allowed only for terminal MERGED or ABORTED state.
Locks have no TTL or automatic timeout. HUMAN_PENDING, STALE and every other non-terminal state preserve ACTIVE lock ownership until explicit terminal release.
REVIEWER, QA and combined REVIEWER_QA roles are read-only and cannot acquire write locks.
Active-lock snapshots and conflict views are deterministic, sorted where applicable, deep-cloned and recursively frozen so callers cannot mutate controller state through returned data.
Existing multi-agent verification automatically includes Item 3 tests without modifying package.json, and the full canonical verification remains green.
PR diff contains only the three declared write-scope files and no forbidden path.

bootstrap.reason: The Scope / Lock Controller cannot govern its own first implementation before it exists canonically.

manual_lock.rule: No concurrent task may mutate these exact paths until the Item 3 PR is merged or aborted. This exception creates no precedent after Item 3 becomes canonical.
